name: Xero Accounting API
tagline: Full accounting API for invoices, contacts, payments, and bank reconciliation.
description: Xero Accounting API provides OAuth 2.0 access to invoices, contacts, payments, bank transactions, accounts, and reports across connected organisations. It supports accounting integrations and bookkeeping automation but does not expose unreconciled bank-statement data or permit bank-statement-line reconciliation through the public Accounting API.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 (authorization code) with tenant connection; Bearer access token plus Xero-Tenant-Id header on Accounting API calls. Apps registered in the Xero Developer portal.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Starter: no charge, maximum 5 connections, unlimited data access, and 1,000 API calls per day per connected organisation.

rate_limits: Per tenant: 5 concurrent calls, 60 calls/minute, and 1,000 calls/day on Starter or 5,000 calls/day on higher tiers; plus 10,000 calls/minute app-wide across all tenants.

example.request: curl -X GET "https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Organisation" -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN" -H "Xero-Tenant-Id: YOUR_TENANT_ID" -H "Accept: application/json"

use_cases: list invoices for a Xero organisation
create a sales invoice for a contact
record a payment against an invoice
sync contacts and customers from Xero
get organisation and chart of accounts details
